checks.name: Incomplete drafts can be saved, then read after leaving the form
Drafts are separated by collector account
Editing keeps the same draft rather than adding a duplicate
Draft snapshots do not change when the form changes later
A storage failure is reported and preserves the previous draft
Corrupted storage is reported without overwriting the stored data
Deleting removes only the chosen draft from the current account
Cover photos survive draft restore, replacement and removal
Drafts can be saved on HTTP LAN previews without randomUUID
